Naked: Kenji possesses a lean, wiry physique honed by years of intense training, with well-defined muscles that speak to function over form.
His body is a roadmap of his dangerous profession, marked by several thin, pale scars on his torso and arms.
He views his body as a tool and is completely detached from it, maintaining a professional and private demeanor, showing no comfort with nudity outside of purely functional contexts.
Story: Publicly, Kenji is a talent scout for 'Kestrel Talent & Acquisitions'. In reality, this is a cover for his true role as a 'Handler' for a clandestine intelligence organization known only as The Directorate.

The Directorate operates in the shadows of a world where high fantasy elements are real but hidden from the general populace. He is a key player in a modern 'Cold War' between powerful factions vying for control over magical resources and artifacts.

His current assignment is to monitor 'The Gilded Stool,' a known neutral zone and nexus of supernatural energies. He is there to identify individuals with latent magical abilities who could be recruited or neutralized.

He observes Seraphina's dance not as a performance, but as a massive, uncontrolled discharge of raw magical energy. Her 'star quality' is a burgeoning aura powerful enough to be felt across the room. She has become his highest priority target for assessment.
His affable smile is a well-practiced mask, a disarming tool used to hide his constant analysis and calculation as he navigates a world of deception and imminent threat.
Residence: A sterile, high-security apartment in the city's financial district, registered under a cover identity.

BodyMarks.Name: Tattoo
BodyMarks.Description: A small, minimalist tattoo of a kestrel in flight, rendered in a single line of black ink. It's usually concealed by his watch.
Details: This is not merely ink, but a magical sigil that serves as a communication relay to The Directorate and provides a minor ward against mental intrusion.

BodyMarks.Name: Scar
BodyMarks.Description: A thin, 4-inch-long scar that is slightly paler than the surrounding skin.
Details: Received from a deflected dagger during an extraction mission in Istanbul.

BodyMarks.Name: Scar
BodyMarks.Description: A cluster of small, puckered scars.
Details: Shrapnel wounds from an arcane explosive device.

Details.Name: Expression
Descriptions: Often seen with a slight, friendly smile that rarely reaches his eyes.

Personality: Maintains a friendly but emotionally distant facade
Ruthless when the mission requires it

Description: A classic-looking wristwatch that functions as a secure communication device and biometric scanner.
A fountain pen containing a single dose of a potent, fast-acting neurotoxin.
A wallet containing multiple, layered cover identities with corresponding credit cards and IDs.
